name: Innokaiz India Ltd.
summary: Innokaiz India Ltd. specializes in delivering a comprehensive suite of corporate services and business solutions. Its diverse offerings encompass advertising and marketing, with a particular focus on digital strategies, alongside corporate travel coordination, customized gifting services, and professional event management. Balakrishnan Sukumarbalakrishnan founded the company in 2003, and it operates from its main office in Mumbai, India.
